# Kshetej Sareen Studios

> Independent photographer based in New Delhi and Bangalore. Editorial, culinary, interiors, portraits, objects, and motion work.

## About

Kshetej Sareen is an independent photographer and visual director working across New Delhi and Bangalore. The studio specialises in editorial and commercial photography across five disciplines: culinary and food & beverage, interior and architectural spaces, portrait work, still life and objects, and motion direction.

Available for commission and print sales.
Contact: info@kshetejsareen.com
